statements.statement: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was performed
The patient presented with recurrent palpitations (R00.2)
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The patient has undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The study was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The findings were needed to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
